entries.title: Psalms 10:1
segments: ¶Why standest thou afar off, O LORD? [why] hidest thou [thyself] in times of trouble?

entries.title: Psalms 10:2
segments: The wicked in [his] pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined. {The wicked...: Heb. In the pride of the wicked he doth persecute}

words.text: . {The wicked...: Heb. In the pride of the wicked he doth persecute}

entries.title: Psalms 10:3
segments: For the wicked boasteth of his heart's desire, and blesseth the covetous, [whom] the LORD abhorreth. {heart's: Heb. soul's} {blesseth...: or, the covetous blesseth himself, he abhorreth the LORD}

words.text: . {heart's: Heb. soul's} {blesseth...: or, the covetous blesseth himself, he abhorreth the LORD}

entries.title: Psalms 10:4
segments: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek [after God]: God [is] not in all his thoughts. {God is...: or, all his thoughts are, There is no God}

words.text: . {God is...: or, all his thoughts are, There is no God}

entries.title: Psalms 10:5
segments: His ways are always grievous; thy judgments [are] far above out of his sight: [as for] all his enemies, he puffeth at them.

words.text: out of his sight: [as for] all his enemies

entries.title: Psalms 10:6
segments: He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for [I shall] never [be] in adversity. {never: Heb. unto generation and generation}

entries.title: Psalms 10:7
segments: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue [is] mischief and vanity. {deceit: Heb. deceits} {vanity: or, iniquity}

entries.title: Psalms 10:8
segments: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor. {are...: Heb. hide themselves}

entries.title: Psalms 10:9
segments: He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor: he doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net. {secretly: Heb. in the secret places}

entries.title: Psalms 10:10
segments: He croucheth, [and] humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones. {He...: Heb. He breaketh himself} {by...: or, into his strong parts}

words.text: . {He...: Heb. He breaketh himself} {by...: or, into his strong parts}

entries.title: Psalms 10:11
segments: He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see [it].

entries.title: Psalms 10:12
segments: ¶Arise, O LORD; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble. {humble: or, afflicted}

entries.title: Psalms 10:13
segments: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God? he hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require [it].

entries.title: Psalms 10:14
segments: Thou hast seen [it]; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite [it] with thy hand: the poor committeth himself unto thee; thou art the helper of the fatherless. {committeth: Heb. leaveth}

words.text: himself unto thee; thou art the helper

entries.title: Psalms 10:15
segments: Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil [man]: seek out his wickedness [till] thou find none.

entries.title: Psalms 10:16
segments: The LORD [is] King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.

entries.title: Psalms 10:17
segments: LORD, thou hast heard the desire of the humble: thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear: {prepare: or, establish}

entries.title: Psalms 10:18
segments: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress. {oppress: or, terrify}
